ns2:course.label: Mod Viewpoints in Psych
ns2:course.description: (PSYCH 360) Examines modern behaviorism, psychoanalysis, and cognitive psychology, viewed as conceptions of man, styles of theorizing and investigative strategies; critically evaluates the more influential theories and research. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Six hours of psychology.
